capabilities: Tag selected PDF passages with tags and an optional note
Draw tagged passages as colored highlights on the page
Browse, filter and jump to tagged passages from a sidebar
Export each tag's quotes to an auto-updated Tag - <tag>.md note
Tag whole PDFs and sync those tags to a companion note's frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a file-tagging tool: passage tags live in the plugin's data.json and the PDFs themselves are never modified.
extras: Tags are stored in the plugin's data.json, not in the PDFs; renaming or deleting a PDF inside Obsidian keeps its tags in sync. Install is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/pdf-tagger/.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF tools let you read and search a PDF but not tag passages with custom tags, notes and colors, or collect tagged quotes across PDFs.
summary: PDF annotation plugin that tags selected passages with colored highlights and notes, browses them in a sidebar, and exports quotes to per-tag notes.
